text: Igraine is a Welsh and Arthurian heroine. Her names include Egraine, Yguerne, Igrayne, Ygerna, Igerna, and Ingraine. The heroic Uther Pendragon saw the beautiful Igraine. He had a strong desire to have her as his partner. Igraine already had Gorlois, the Duke of Cornwall, as her partner. She had no desire for Uther. Uther conspired with the magician Merlin. Uther changed his appearance. Igraine believed she was sleeping with her husband. Her companion was in fact the bewitched Uther. From this union the future king Arthur was conceived. News of the death of Gorlois then reached Igraine. She married Uther, who had resumed his original appearance. Igraine had other children by Gorlois. Two had similar names and may come from the same source: Morgause and Morgan were often confused in legend. The other child was Elaine of Garlot.
